description: Burst8 supported-case packet. Each positive case pairs a schema-valid synthetic base-scene/v0 source (metres, hand-authored) with an independently authored root-wire scene (feet, hand-derived as metres divided by 0.3048 and rounded to six decimals) — the same wall, on-wall meter anchor, observed wall_rect hazard, level ground, coverage gap, and chain ends, described twice by construction, never produced by running the converter.

Positive cases run the unchanged top-level solver through POST /v1/placements on the wire scene and on the bridge's conversion of the source scene; the two responses must agree except stats.elapsed_ms (timing) and stats.input_sha256 plus response.input_sha256 (the posted bytes differ: the wire file carries a schema_version envelope field the bridge does not emit). They must also match these expectations, derived from the authored dimensions: the spot is the last failing start pushed to the 3 ft gas-clearance line (gas edge + 3.0), gas_clearance is unsure by margin (measured exactly 3.0 ft against 0.590552 ft of uncertainty), the ground gap makes ground_surface unsure-unobserved, and the unexplored end within reach asks for a walk past it. The merged ground band's six-decimal extent is the buffer union over the authored gaps and the clearance radii of rules.yaml; its span and out_ft are pinned as the serialized geometric consequence of the authored dimensions.

Negative cases are source-only: the bridge must refuse them with the declared error code and pointer. multiwall-source-unsupported and generated-object-evidence-unsupported are newly authored to be clean of every other unsupported feature, so the declared refusal is the scene's first one. The other three preserve W7's documented bridge limitations: standoff-meter-anchor-unsupported is a byte-identical copy of the W7 hazard-right-ground-gap source, generated-regions-unsupported a byte-identical copy of the W7 generated-hazard source, and footprint-hazard-unsupported is the W7 right source with only the meter's standoff_m field removed so the footprint hazard is the first unsupported feature left (its hash pins the derived bytes).
Every fixture path is relative to this manifest's directory and pinned by sha256; a missing or drifted file fails the suite with its path.

cases.note: Geometry facts, not policy: the wall runs s [-1.5, 10.0] ft with a limit left end and an unexplored right end; the gas meter at s [3.0, 4.0] ft pushes the best spot to the 3 ft clearance line (s0 = 4.0 + 3.0 = 7.0, measured 3.0 ft +- 0.590552, unsure by margin, not by observation); every start closer to the meter either overlaps the working space or the meter (estimate-failing) and every start past the clearance line has unsure ground too but a longer route. The wall_rect vent obj-tap-vent (the replay runner's TAP_HAZARD geometry) sits at s [5.249344, 5.905512] ft +- 0.164042: the chosen spot clears it (gap 1.094488 ft), while the pinned sweep runs overlap the gas meter and the vent — the second run ends exactly at the vent's tolerance line 5.905512 + 0.164042 = 6.069554. Ground is observed only at [-1.5, 3.0] and [8.5, 10.0] ft out 13, so the spot's ground is unsure-unobserved and the response must request the ground band and a walk past the right end.

Geometry facts, not policy: the wall runs s [-10.0, 3.5] ft with an unexplored left end and a limit right end; the gas meter at s [-4.0, -3.0] ft pushes the best spot left onto the 3 ft clearance line (s1 = -4.0 - 3.0 = -7.0, s0 = -9.583333, measured 3.0 ft +- 0.590552, unsure by margin), and the wall's left end at -10.0 leaves no room for a fully clear gas spot so every left candidate keeps the gas unsure. Ground is observed only at [-10.0, -9.5] and [-1.0, 3.5] ft out 12, so the spot's ground is unsure-unobserved; the right stretch near the meter is blocked by the working space (the pinned meter_working_space run starts exactly at -(0.09 m + 0.09 m) = -0.590552 ft) and the wall's short right end blocks the rest. The response must request the ground band and a walk past the left end.

Awaiting conversion: an L of two house walls with everything else inside the bridge's bounded scope (observed on-wall meter anchor, observed wall_rect hazard, level ground, band coverage, contract-valid chain ends), so the two-wall chain is the scene's first unsupported feature and the bridge must decline it with code placement_scene_unsupported at pointer /walls. This suite never runs the missing bridge, and this case is never reported as a successful conversion.

Awaiting conversion: one straight wall with an observed on-wall meter anchor and one window object the producer completed rather than observed (evidence generated), with no generated_regions, no keyframes and band coverage, so the object's evidence is the scene's first unsupported feature and the bridge must decline it with code placement_scene_unsupported at pointer /objects/1/evidence. This suite never runs the missing bridge, and this case is never reported as a successful conversion.

Awaiting conversion: a byte-identical copy of the W7 hazard-right-ground-gap source, preserved unchanged so the declared refusal is the scene's actual first one — the stand-off meter anchor the bridge does not synthesise, at /objects/0/geometry/standoff_m. The suite never runs the missing bridge, and this case is never reported as a successful conversion.

Awaiting conversion: the W7 hazard-right-ground-gap source with only the meter anchor's standoff_m field removed (the scene is otherwise byte-for-byte the same document re-serialized), so the stand-off refusal no longer fires first and the footprint gas_meter hazard is the first unsupported feature left. The bridge must decline it with code placement_scene_unsupported at pointer /objects/1/geometry/kind. The suite never runs the missing bridge, and this case is never reported as a successful conversion.

Awaiting conversion: a byte-identical copy of the W7 generated-hazard source, preserved unchanged and declared at its actual first refusal /generated_regions (generated regions are unknown space, not observed geometry) rather than the /objects/1/evidence pointer its W7 manifest entry declared. The suite never runs the missing bridge, and this case is never reported as a successful conversion.
